posts.text: Beware that there are a ton of bots pretending to be climate activists right now. They are spreading climate doom and attempting to discredit the scientists who refute it. posts.text: What a powerful piece that proves just how big of an issue funding is in climate spaces. I’m grateful to have built up enough paid subscribers on Good Climate News to cover my mortgage, but neither of us should have to do this on a volunteer basis! Organizations should absolutely pay up!
